entries.statement: The existing sweep awaits initialization, response and cleanup with sixty-second phase budgets and surfaces its named deadline outside the product-raiser classifier.

proofs.facet: The control drives a registered never-answering tool through EntryPointWorld.call with a shortened response budget, asserts _ToolCallTimeout names the tool and response phase, and checks handler cleanup and a subsequent usable call. This is a recorded static test relationship, not evidence that this session executed the test.

admission.justification: Reporting branch movement when the re-read tip is unchanged would conceal a real Git hook or lock refusal. Re-reading the intended ref distinguishes an actual concurrent tip change from a failed update at the admitted tip and preserves Git's diagnostic in the latter case.

history.subject: INV-753SKJFF
history.reason: MIK-R26 deliberately supersedes dataset selection: resolve_published_intent selects the converted tree's index and refuses legacy roots. The original dataset and not-recorded promises are preserved only in prior Git history. K03 successor corrects RLZ-K64BDQNF itself: converted roots select their derived index; unconverted roots refuse legacy-format, without selecting a canonical dataset.

covers.rationale: resolve_published_intent resolves the admitted repository or leaf memory root, refuses an unconverted root as legacy-format, and selects the derived index of the converted root's exact text tree. An index selection or identity failure is reported unusable rather than selecting another memory layer or publishing a canonical database.

history.subject: INV-W4XGR4
history.reason: The live sweep-timeout guarantee moved to the extracted world and its control; the earlier false retirement remains replaced. K04 successor now records the actual phase-budget enforcement at EntryPointWorld._call and writes a typed proves entry for the extracted never-answer control. The earlier fix2 claim that a support realization re-anchored the proof was incorrect; it remains preserved in the reviewed report and Git before-half. No test execution is claimed.

covers.rationale: EntryPointWorld._call wraps session initialization, tool response and session cleanup in the phase budgets, resets the deadline at each transition, and raises _ToolCallTimeout with tool name and phase on timeout; call re-raises that named exception outside the product-raiser classifier.
